watch.summary: The creator notices there are 666 teams in a humanoid robot competition and treats it as an ominous apocalyptic sign.

beats.what: The creator reads a news report about the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games.
He notices the report mentions exactly 666 teams.
He reacts in disbelief, questioning why there would be 666 teams.
He zooms in on a meme below the tweet of a panicked dog holding a cross and Holy Bible.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Why would you have 666 teams, bro?
watch.why: The comedy stems from the absurd coincidence of 666 robot teams and the streamer treating it as a biblical bad omen. The visual punchline of the dog holding a cross lands the joke perfectly.
